hypothesis_tested: Q_geom = 1/(CLS orbital/sublattice support), via inverse participation ratio (IPR) of |u(k)|^2 over orbitals, across a TUNABLE family at fixed N_band

tunable_families.dice_phi: 3-band chiral dice, rim-B rotated by phi in [0.05, pi/2] (7 pts, all flat width<3e-15)
tunable_families.stub_flat: 3-orbital cross-stub chain, alpha tunes A:B backbone weight (flat only at isolated alpha -> mostly dropped)
tunable_families.lieb_w: 3-band anisotropic Lieb, edge couplings (tx=1, ty in [0.25,3]) (7 pts, all EXACTLY flat width=0)
tunable_families.sawtooth: 1D Delta chain, r tunes base:apex weight (flat only at r=sqrt(2) -> 1 pt kept)

naive_hypothesis_outcome.note: single-k orbital-IPR mean FAILS as a universal predictor (r=-0.14); naive Q=1/round(N_orb) FAILS (residual 0.49). dice_phi contaminated by a phase-winding-collapse point (phi~1.06: Q->0.988). BUT per-family Lieb r=+0.9996 flagged a real conditional signal -> pursued in R8b/R8c.

BREAKTHROUGH_closed_form.statement: For a 2-orbital-support flat band u(k)=(sqrt(wA(k)), sqrt(wB(k)) e^{i ph(k)}): Q_geom = <|<u(k)|u(k')>|^2>_{k,k'} = Q_diag + Q_phase
BREAKTHROUGH_closed_form.Q_diag: <sum_m w_m(k) w_m(k')>_{k,k'} = phase-blind orbital-weight TWO-POINT correlator (the orbital-support term)
BREAKTHROUGH_closed_form.Q_phase: inter-orbital BZ phase-coherence correction = 2 wA wB |<e^{i ph}>_k|^2 for k-constant weights; VANISHES iff the CLS inter-orbital relative phase fully winds over the BZ
BREAKTHROUGH_closed_form.derivation_check: R8b: u=(cos th0, sin th0 e^{i wk}), phase winding w>=1 -> Q_geom = wA^2+wB^2 = IPR EXACTLY across all orbital imbalances th0 (residual <1e-4). Non-winding phase -> Q_geom rises above IPR by 2 wA wB |<e^iph>|^2.

Lieb_family_identity.note: Q_full = Q_diag to 1e-8 for ALL 7 anisotropic-Lieb points; Q_phase=0 identically (real edge couplings -> no inter-orbital winding-coherence)

all_flat.note: aggregate spoiled by the 4 phase-COHERENT dice_phi points where Q_phase up to 0.488

verdict: REFINED-POSITIVE (supersedes naive r8): Q_geom is NOT 1/(orbital count) and NOT the single-k orbital IPR. The EXACT determinant is Q_geom = Q_diag + Q_phase, where Q_diag is the phase-blind orbital-weight TWO-POINT BZ correlator (the genuine orbital-support term) and Q_phase is an inter-orbital phase-coherence correction that vanishes iff the CLS inter-orbital relative phase fully winds. On the phase-decorrelated flat family Q_geom = Q_diag with r=0.9975 (max residual 0.020); on the clean anisotropic-Lieb family the identity is exact to 1e-8. Orbital support is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT: the second, co-equal determinant is inter-orbital BZ phase decorrelation.

depletion.branch: (i)-refined: a clean predictor IS found, but it is a TWO-TERM law (orbital-weight 2pt correlator + phase coherence), not the single-term 1/N_orb the round hypothesized
depletion.status: NOT depleted -- a NEW, sharp axis opened (inter-orbital phase winding as the co-determinant). r9 should test the phase term directly across an N_orb>2 family and on a Chern-tuned family to confirm Q_phase is topology-INDEPENDENT (consistent with r7), closing Q_geom = Q_diag + Q_phase to paper-grade.
depletion.paper_eligible_now: PARTIAL -- the closed form + Lieb exact identity (1e-8) is a falsifiable, measured finding (Delta vs the naive 1/N_orb hypothesis). Recommend r9 confirmation before /paper.
